title: Tribal Movements Rampa Rebellion
definition: The Rampa Rebellion (1922-1924) was a major tribal uprising in the Godavari agency of the Madras Presidency, led by Alluri Sitarama Raju against the oppressive British colonial forest laws and the exploitation of tribal communities.
importanceInUpsc: It is a critical topic in Modern Indian History, testing the intersection of tribal agency, colonial forest policy, and the influence of the Non-Cooperation Movement on regional uprisings.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tribal Movements Rampa Rebellion.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Tribal social structure in Andhra region
